detailed_description: Our free color contrast checker helps designers and developers ensure their websites meet WCAG accessibility standards. Color contrast is crucial for users with visual impairments, including color blindness and low vision. This tool calculates the contrast ratio between foreground (text) and background colors according to WCAG 2.1 guidelines. WCAG Level AA requires a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text (18pt or 14pt bold). Level AAA requires 7:1 for normal text and 4.5:1 for large text. Simply enter your hex color codes or use the color picker to test combinations. The tool instantly shows pass/fail results for both AA and AAA compliance levels. Essential for creating accessible websites, mobile apps, and digital content that everyone can read.
usage_steps: Enter your foreground (text) color using hex code or color picker
Enter your background color using hex code or color picker
View the calculated contrast ratio instantly
Check pass/fail status for WCAG AA and AAA levels
Use preset combinations or swap colors to test alternatives
